_doc: Rustvane Canyon (LEVELS[1]) greybox, BS_LEVELS §3 (remade). Frame: metres, north = -z, y up. Boxes are centre + size. Flags without a dot are level-local (BS flag 'rustvane.<name>'); flags with a dot are global. Source refs: buildLevel2 L9744, expandRustvane L9477, buildAnnex L9240 (ox moved from 22 to 34 to clear the remake's east wall), addBouncePad L8931, addUpdraft L8939, addRail/updateRail L7872/L3101, poolScene L8200, MEMO_SPOTS L13002. Tether-Hook gates are vertical (pull points 9+ m up): Bolt's own jump + double jump + hover covers ~31 m flat and ~5.4 m up (measured), so a flat gap can't require the hook. Built by RustvaneDirector (bs/world/rustvane/).
name: RUSTVANE CANYON

props._: CANYON WALLS (solid banded strata): west, east (split by the Strip Mine corridor), the mouth, the far wall past the lava
Strip Mine corridor and Quarry Floor walls
HUB: rating sign, valet loop, parasol, boardwalk dressing
RESORT DECKS: stilts, cabanas, parasols, deck chairs, floaties
BACK OF HOUSE: bunks stacked like luggage, break area, vending, time clock, laundry, string lights
SUNSET STAGE: deck chairs, string lights

boxes._: GROUND (top y 0): west bank, east bank (cut for the ore trench), river strip, riverbed (top -3), north floor
HUB: pad, ship, concierge desk, gift shop, river boardwalk
CLIFF LEDGES (source switchbacks) against the east cliff block (x 18..34, top 9) with the secret cave notch
RIVER ROUTE: five stepping stones (source), the waterfall outcrop with the grotto pocket (gold 1)
COLLAPSED MINE (1,40): tunnel, back wall with the timbered passage (S3), back room
OLD CO-OP CAMP: slab (top 0.4), the ore trench (floor -2.5), practice ledges A/B/C on the cliff (tops 9.5 / 12 / 9.5)
RESORT DECKS on stilts: A (top 6.5) with the infinity pool, steps, B and C (top 7.7)
BACK OF HOUSE extras: sign posts, break awning + table, dumpster, overhead pipes, the drip
STRIP MINE RIM (top 18), tower T1, ledge M (top 11) for the second updraft
ZIP TOWERS: T2 (top 10), T3 (top 20, the hook pull), legs; the TOP BILLBOARD DECK (top 22) and the gold side board
THE STRIP MINE corridor (floor top 0, x 34..63): staggered slabs, wall-kick shaft, top ledge, the ore gantry (top 27.5), the quarry fence (top 24)
THE QUARRY FLOOR (top 0.5) with the east terrace (top 5.5), the plunge pool, the updraft vault shelf (S8), the high ore-cart shelf (S5, gold 4)
S7: the second-sun projector rig on a north-east rim ledge (top 9), a Glide target from the Top Billboard Deck
CLIFF ROOST (S4) on the east wall, top 16
VIP LANDING (top 8.4) with railings, the glass VIP walls along the deck's south edge, THE SUNSET STAGE deck (top 8.4) and its show pool

water._: water-type liquids (8 damage, reset, splash quip). The river (BS_LEVELS 3.12), deck A's infinity pool and the show pool (scalding), the quarry plunge pool

rails._: golden ride-rails and cliff zip lines (ZipRider). 'end': 'soft' = the line ends on a tower or landing (step off at 4 m/s)

gadget_points._: marker-only gadget secrets (Glide arrives on Verdant Sink)

tether_points._: orange = swing, green = pull ('land' = reel end relative to the ring, on the approach side of the lip)

updrafts._: canyon wind updrafts (BS_LEVELS 3.5): r 2.4, h 12, force 30, pulse 3 s on / 1.5 s off

umbrellas._: bounce umbrellas (power 16-20, source): the river-route launch to deck C and two rescue umbrellas under the high route

billboards._: floating billboard platforms (sine bob 0.9 m, speed 0.8, phase n*1.4; source) with ad panels (ads.json billboards[n])

switches._: gadget switches: Magma (F) on the mine timbers, Thunder (Z) on the vending machine

gold_bolts.how: source #2: secret cave in the east cliff
S5: end of the ore-cart line (Grind Soles)

the infinity edge of deck A
security kennel on deck C, by the vest rack
Selfie Sentry charging dock, Cliff Ledges (source spot)
Back of House laundry, under the pool's drip

encounters._: GLAMBOT Pop-Up Segment (BS_LEVELS 3.11): five waves of resort enemies plus Review Bombers

rustvane_sentinel.name: RUSTVANE SENTINEL

phases._: BS_LEVELS 3.10: Unboxing low (4 m) -> Collab drifts along the north edge -> Going live rises to 8 m

triggers._: OUT OF BOUNDS quips (BS_LEVELS 3.12): walls, the river, the pools, the lava and the mine pit; 20 s cooldown

quest_hints._doc: BS_LEVELS 0.6: Sprocket barks when an active quest's item/target is within radius, once per cooldown

cutscenes._doc: Level-owned cutscene scripts (CutscenePlayer step format). ccIntro and l2_glambot replace the story file's camera steps (which aim at the web build's 'miniboss' with JS helpers) with Sunset Stage anchors; the lines are the original ids, unchanged.
